sources.prompt: Carefully repair the ink contour thickness of THREE supplied Kun avatar wearing overlays. No black/white background or checkerboard. Do not include bird, body, mannequin, text, labels, shadow or any unrelated specks. These are WEARING layers not inventory icons: preserve the flattened proportions of the first two references and the exact quill diagonal. LEFT: the purple BERET from reference1, a very wide low stretched oval soft hat, width2.74timesheight INCLUDING short stalk on upper-left, long axis rising toward right only about12degrees, a narrow dark-violet band along the underside, violet material in two cel tones and one muted upper-right spot of highlight. Keep original wide flat profile and same upper-left short stalk position, no underside opening. REDRAW outer contour in uniform clean navy #0e2f66, noticeably thinner than reference: outer stroke width2.5% of overall hat width (target18px when hat width720px), and inner seam thickness1%width; do not scale whole hat to change thickness, locally redraw ink instead. Remove tiny unrelated dark fragment to right of reference. MIDDLE: the DARK NAVY SQUARE EYEGLASSES from reference2, strictly FRONT-facing symmetric two large rounded-square windows, straight upper rims, short side hinges, curved small central bridge; overall width2.71timesheight. Keep original positions and proportions of the two lens windows. REDRAW navy #0e2f66 frame as slimmer even-width band about2.9%of overall glasses width (target20px atwidth678px; maximum24px). Lenses are TRANSPARENT clear windows through which avatar eyes will stay fully visible; small pale-blue translucent highlight confined to very upper-left of each lens only, rest clear alpha. No cloudy diagonal lens filling, no opaque white glass; do not add long arms across lens openings. Small subtle blue-gray highlight on outside upper rim. RIGHT: the CREAM FEATHER QUILL from reference3, long pointed feather with same four deep angled notches along each side, slender dark brown shaft running from bottom-left to upper-right, ratio width0.684timesheight, overall diagonal about35degrees from vertical. Preserve tip, silhouette and color: warm ivory with a few pale beige cel barbs, brown shaft. REDRAW its navy #0e2f66 outer contour THICKER than reference: uniform outer stroke about3.15%of quill overall height (target12px when quill height380px), seam or barb marks far thinner. It must read as same feather, not a leaf. For all three use navy near #0e2f66 only for outer ink (NOT nearly black), preserve two-tone cel shading and clean readable local ink. No gradients, no airbrush, no synthetic vector look. Essential: the BERET and GLASSES must be wide FLAT profiles with width almost3xheight, while the QUILL must remain tall diagonal. Do not enlarge their outline widths together: beret thinner, glasses thinner, quill thicker relative to their own reference.
